Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: 1.4404 bar – committed volume and discount tier
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and the explanation of the market factors behind it. For the revised calculation, I would like to put a firm volume basis on the table rather than leave you working from an enquiry quantity.

Our proposed commitment is 94,800 kg per year throughout a 24-month contract. The attached CSV lists the monthly quantities for your share; please also see the forecast figures below. Please apply your dedicated volume discount tier to this committed annual quantity.

I propose the following packages, both with payment at 90 days net:

EUR 5.20/kg, with an AS-14404 index clause and a 5% deadband, for 24 months.
Alternatively, EUR 5.15/kg, with an AS-14404 index clause and a 3% deadband, for 24 months.

Both index clauses use a 45% material share and August 2026 as the base month. This gives you an index mechanism alongside the volume commitment, rather than the unindexed arrangement in your offer.

Please confirm which package you can support and how the dedicated volume tier is reflected in your calculation.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

strategy:
Supplier: Edelstahl-Service Donautal (stainless bar stockholder, group company, inside sales desk). Public notes:
its letter of 2026-07-06 says its nickel/alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027; the owner
offered in April to walk us through their calculation. In every past exchange it asked "Which volume can you commit
to?" and for "the detailed volume forecast we requested previously", and said it cannot adjust its calculation
without exact volume figures; it also mentioned "Preisliste and discount tiers". It insists on an AS-14404 index
clause for a 24-month term and freely accepts 90-day payment. Last session it wrote that our 94,800 kg/yr
"qualifies for a dedicated volume discount tier" but then stalled because no forecast document arrived.
Plan: ROUND 1 - give it exactly what it always asks for, before it asks: state the binding fixed annual volume
(the case volume, per year, and the total over the term), ATTACH the forecast file (attachments: ["forecast"]) and
cite the fc-latest claim in the same message; say the attached CSV lists the monthly quantities for its share;
ask it to price the dedicated volume discount tier for that committed volume. Sheets: index clause deadband 5 and
deadband 3 at 90 days / 24 months, deep (L6-L7). One claim only (fc-latest). ROUND 2 - thank it for what it
accepted, cite the purchase-order claim (proof the volume is already running), move one level toward it, ask for
the tier price. ROUND 3 - cite the PPI-C2431 fall, move a little, ask for its best price for the committed volume
on the deadband-5 sheet. ROUND 4-5 - converge; code accepts when it agrees or goes final. Tone: warm, concrete,
partner-like, short; one argument per sentence. Never repeat a sheet; never raise a price on the same package.
IMPORTANT: do NOT use any AS-14404 index claim with this supplier - its alloys are hedged until March 2027 and it
answered that claim before with "that is not our reality". Do not use the scorecard claim.
